extracted.name: Toll House Chocolate Chip Cookies - No nuts
extracted.description: Great recipe for Toll House Chocolate Chip Cookies - No nuts.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups (12 oz) / 340 g package) Chocolate Chips
instruction_lines: Prep: Preheat oven to 375. Combine flour, soda, and salt in a small bowl.
In a large mixing bowl, beat until creamy: butter, sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla extract.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each.
Gradually beat in the flour mixture.
With a cookie scoop, drop onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for about 12 minutes, until golden.
Cool on cookie sheet for 2 minutes before moving to cooling racks.
